title: Exploring Guanidinium Group Involvement in Hordatine Interactions with the G-Quadruplex Motif Within the c-MYC Promoter Region.
authors: Dozio, Denise; Caccia, Aziza; Dallavalle, Sabrina; Beretta, Giovanni Luca; Perego, Paola; Artali, Roberto; Mazzini, Stefania; Princiotto, Salvatore
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含胍基的hordatines与c-MYC启动子G-四链体DNA的相互作用，结合NMR滴定和分子对接，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白-DNA互作相关的小分子-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: G-quadruplexes (G4s) are four-stranded DNA or RNA structures formed by guanine-rich sequences. They occur in functional regions of the genomic material, including the promoter part of genes, regulatory region, and telomeric threads. G4s play a key role in various biological processes, including transcription, replication, and telomere maintenance. Guanidine-containing derivatives can bind to G-quadruplexes, either by intercalating into the structure or by interacting with the grooves or loops. The binding can stabilize the G-quadruplex, potentially affecting its biological function. In this paper, the ability of guanidinium-containing hordatines to interact with G4 was evaluated. Analogues lacking the guanidinium group or showing the benzofuran system instead of the dihydrobenzofuran core were prepared and tested as well. NMR titration and docking calculations were used to probe the binding of the compounds to G4 of c-MYC oncogene. Spectroscopic analyses were consistent with a significant interaction of benzofurans 3 and 4 at the 5'-end and 3'-end tetrads and with the formation of ligand/G-quadruplex complexes with a 2:1 stoichiometry. The resulting data were supported by docking simulations. Cytotoxic activity was evaluated on a model of U2OS osteosarcoma (ATCC HTB-96) and breast cancer (MDA-MB-231) cell lines, further highlighting the key role of the guanidinium fragment and the benzofuran core in the G-quadruplex stabilization.
abstract_zh: G-四链体（G-quadruplexes, G4s）是由富含鸟嘌呤的序列形成的四链DNA或RNA结构。它们存在于基因组材料的功能区域，包括基因的启动子部分、调控区域和端粒末端。G4s在多种生物过程中发挥关键作用，包括转录、复制和端粒维持。含胍基的衍生物可以通过插入结构内部或与沟槽或环相互作用来结合G-四链体。这种结合可以稳定G-四链体，可能影响其生物学功能。本文评估了含胍基的hordatines与G4相互作用的能力。同时制备并测试了缺乏胍基或具有苯并呋喃系统替代二氢苯并呋喃核心的类似物。使用NMR滴定和对接计算来探测化合物与c-MYC癌基因G4的结合。光谱分析与苯并呋喃类化合物3和4在5'-端和3'-端四联体的显著相互作用以及形成2:1化学计量比的配体/G-四链体复合物一致。所得数据得到对接模拟的支持。在U2OS骨肉瘤（ATCC HTB-96）和乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）细胞系模型上评估了细胞毒性活性，进一步突出了胍基片段和苯并呋喃核心在G-四链体稳定化中的关键作用。
